description: If a complete consistent Henkin set \(S\) contains \(\forall x\forall y\,(x=y)\), its nonempty term-model domain has exactly one element.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.term_model_subsingleton.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {S : Set (L.Formula ℕ)} (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent S)
  (hC : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Complete S)
  (hH : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Henkin S)
  (hAll :
    FirstOrder.Language.Formula.relabel Empty.elim (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.allPairEqual L) ∈
      S) :
  Subsingleton (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.TermModel S hS hC)
